items.title: Mamdani’s Consumer Cop to Begin Tech Oversight Push Within Weeks
items.author: Laura Nahmias and María Paula Mijares Torres
items.content: <article>New York City’s consumer protection chief said a new enforcement unit to police predatory corporate practices will begin work within weeks, with the gig economy among its priorities.</article>

items.title: NATO Picks Germany’s Top Defense Official to Be Military Chief
items.author: Andrea Palasciano and Marilen Martin
items.content: <article>NATO chose German General Carsten Breuer to chair the alliance’s military committee in a nod to Berlin’s booming defense industry and rearmament drive.</article>

items.title: Dutch Police Break Up Violent Far-Right Protest in The Hague
items.author: Patrick Van Oosterom
items.content: <article>Dutch police broke up a far-right protest of several hundred demonstrators in The Hague after it turned violent on Saturday.</article>

items.title: JD Vance’s Yale Years Offer Clues to His Politics
items.content: <article>Vanity Fair contributing writer Chris Whipple spent six months examining JD Vance’s years at Yale Law School, including the influence of professor Amy Chua and previously unreported contacts in which Whipple says Vance offered Hillary Clinton’s 2016 campaign advice on defeating Donald Trump. Whipple is on Bloomberg This Weekend and discusses how his reporting traces Vance’s evolution from a prominent Trump critic to Trump’s vice president, while examining the relationships and experiences that helped shape his political career.   (Source: Bloomberg)</article>

items.title: US Tariffs Threaten Great Lakes Shipping Tied to Canada Trade
items.author: Brendan Murray
items.content: <article>The American Century often draws a crowd when the ship pulls into the Port of Duluth-Superior to load Minnesota iron ore. Kids cheer when the captain blasts the fog horn. A voice on the loudspeaker retells the story of how the 1,000-foot-long bulk carrier has sailed the Great Lakes for nearly a half century.</article>

items.title: EU Presses Partners to Deliver Ukraine Funding Ahead of UN Week
items.author: Jorge Valero and Alessandra Migliaccio
items.content: <article>The European Union is pressing international partners to provide funding to Ukraine as the country faces increasing financing needs amid a tense battlefield situation before the winter.</article>

items.title: CNN, MS NOW Barred From White House After Ban by Trump
items.author: Kevin Whitelaw and Josh Wingrove
items.content: <article>MS NOW, CNN and Politico said their journalists were denied access to the White House grounds on Saturday after President Donald Trump said he would bar the outlets.</article>

items.title: China Slams US Law Tightening Sanctions on Russia and Iran
items.author: Bloomberg News
items.content: <article>China criticized the new US law that strengthens sanctions on Russia and extends trade measures on Iran, which was signed late Friday by President Donald Trump.</article>

items.title: Malaysian Minister to Resign after 1MDB Pardon Sparks Criticism
items.author: Anders Melin and Ram Anand
items.content: <article>Malaysian Transport Minister Anthony Loke said he plans to resign from cabinet in response to the conditional pardon given to former Prime Minister Najib Razak related to his role in one of the largest corruption scandals in modern history.</article>

items.title: Midterm Voting Starts in Key States With Election 45 Days Out
items.author: Caitlin Reilly
items.content: <article>It’s 45 days before an Election Day that will determine control of Congress for the remainder of President Donald Trump’s second term and 20 states are already mailing ballots to voters. That includes the hard-fought Senate contests in Texas, Michigan and North Carolina.</article>

items.title: US to Return $2.5 Million From Asset Tied to Ex-Gambian Dictator
items.author: Modou Joof
items.content: <article>The US will transfer $2.5 million recovered from a Maryland property tied to former Gambian dictator Yahya Jammeh to compensate eligible victims of his more than 22-year rule.</article>

items.title: UK Mansion Tax May Expand to Homes Worth Over £1.5 Million
items.author: Harry Wilson
items.content: <article>The UK’s Labour government is examining plans to expand a new property tax to include homes worth more than £1.5 million ($2 million), according to The Times newspaper, citing unnamed government sources.</article>

items.title: US, China Trade Teams Set to Huddle in New York on AI, Iran
items.author: Colum Murphy, Alicia Diaz and Yash Roy
items.content: <article>US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and China’s Vice Premier He Lifeng will lead talks on trade and other pressure points Sunday in New York ahead of next week’s summit between the leaders of the world’s two biggest economies.</article>

items.title: US Reaches Greenland Deal to End Row That Threatened NATO
items.author: Sanne Wass
items.content: <article>The US, Denmark and Greenland struck a security deal that expands Washington’s role on the Arctic island, ending for now a long-running diplomatic spat without ceding land to the US.</article>

items.title: US Lifts Sanctions Aimed at Eritrea’s Ruling Party and Military
items.author: Janice Kew
items.content: <article>The US is letting lapse its five-year national emergency over the conflict and humanitarian crisis in Ethiopia, lifting sanctions on Eritrea’s military, ruling party and other individuals and entities targeted under the measure.</article>

items.title: Saudi Arabia Issues Rare Air-Raid Alerts for Riyadh
items.author: Fiona MacDonald and Sara Gharaibeh
items.content: <article>Saudi Arabian authorities issued air-raid alerts for Riyadh early Saturday, the first in the capital since the height of the US-Iran war in March and April.</article>

items.title: German Elections on Baltic Coast and Berlin May Seal Merz’s Fate
items.author: Arne Delfs and Michael Nienaber
items.content: <article>Campaigning in the Baltic port city of Rostock this week, the eastern German state premier seeking to extend her nine-year tenure took Friedrich Merz to task for failing to address surging fuel prices.</article>

items.title: Andy Burnham to Meet Donald Trump as Aides Blame President for Economic Woes
items.author: Alex Wickham
items.content: <article>Andy Burnham is about to come face-to-face with the man his own officials blame for the UK government’s economic predicament: Donald Trump.</article>

items.title: Japan, US Agree To Deepen Security Ties as Koizumi Stays in Post
items.author: Takashi Mochizuki
items.content: <article>Japan’s Defense Minister Shinjiro Koizumi and US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth agreed in a phone call to further strengthen security ties after Koizumi retained his post in a cabinet reshuffle by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi.</article>

items.title: Germany Agrees on €2.5 Billion Fuel Relief, Price Cap Plan
items.author: Kamil Kowalcze
items.content: <article>Germany’s federal and state governments agreed on a €2.5 billion ($2.9 billion) relief package including a three-month fuel-tax cut from October and plans for a temporary cap on pump prices to cushion motorists and businesses.</article>
